count_state_definition: Eight counts: B/F/S/margin passes in each three-block registry; every count ranges from 0 to 3.
invalid_policy: Invalid rows are not enumerated as failures here; any missing registered row makes the empirical candidate decision Invalid.
logical_note: At the registered 5-of-6 total and 2-of-3 per-registry thresholds, the per-registry count gates are logically entailed by the total gate. They remain explicit audit checks for registry materialization and reporting.
probability_model: None registered. B/F/S success and paired-margin counts are dependent within blocks, so no factorized admission probability is reported.
